# Avatar

Avatar is a dark theme whose accents, aqua, purple, gold and pink, are drawn from the four elements. It gives each heading level from H1 to H6 its own colour, reworks text and code block appearance, tints links, and gives tables gradient headers with hover effects. Colours and styling are exposed as CSS custom properties for further editing.

![Avatar screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cxj05h/obsidian-avatar/HEAD/Avatar_Theme.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Avatar"
    author: "cxj05h"
    repo:   "cxj05h/obsidian-avatar"
    slug:   "avatar"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/avatar"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/cxj05h/obsidian-avatar"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cxj05h/obsidian-avatar/HEAD/Avatar_Theme.png"

    modes: ["dark"]
    about: "Apply a vibrant dark theme inspired by the four elements with aqua, purple, gold, and pink accents. Style headings (H1–H6) with custom colors, polish text and code block appearance, tint links, and give tables gradient headers with hover effects. Customize colors and styling via CSS custom properties."
}
```
